The epitope-specific mAb positively selected reactive fragments from a combinatorial HA (A/Anhui/1/05) antigen library displayed on the surface of yeast. The minimal sequence recognized by the mAb and four other mAbs was residues between I60 and G263 (F60–263 using H3 numbering) in the HA1 region. Mutations D77G or E119K nearly abolished the ability of the mAb to neutralize the pseudovirus and mutations P125H or S126bF increased the concentration of mAb required for pseudovirus neutralization, indicating these are important residues for antibody recognition.
